recognize_zh: 中倍下可見大量小淋巴球與漿細胞，混雜著成群淡染、泡沫狀細胞質的大型組織球（右下較明顯），間有纖細膠原化基質，呈 Rosai-Dorfman 病的「淡色組織球與深色淋巴漿細胞交錯」圖樣。
features: Mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes and plasma cells, denser in upper half
Clusters of large pale histiocytes with abundant clear-to-foamy cytoplasm, prominent lower right
Interspersed collagen bands with focal sclerosis
Emperipolesis not clearly resolved at this magnification
describe_en: Sections at intermediate power show a dense mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes and plasma cells alternating with clusters of large histiocytes with abundant pale to foamy cytoplasm, set in a collagenous stroma with scattered adipocytes. The alternating pattern of pale histiocyte-rich areas and dark lymphoplasmacytic areas is evident. Emperipolesis is not well resolved at this magnification and is better assessed at high power or on S100 stain. Findings are consistent with extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.vs: IgG4-RD has storiform fibrosis and obliterative phlebitis without sheets of large pale S100+ histiocytes.
IMT features spindled myofibroblasts in fascicles with ALK expression rather than large rounded S100+ histiocytes.
LCH cells are smaller with grooved nuclei and eosinophils and are CD1a/langerin positive.
Lymphomas show light-chain restricted plasma cells and a monotypic B-cell population without emperipolesis-bearing histiocytes.
